biography: Robbi Pérez, born under the scorching sun of Rio de Janeiro, carries the vibrant energy of his homeland onto the racetrack. His journey began not on asphalt, but on the sandy beaches of Copacabana, where he raced anything with wheels – from makeshift skateboards to souped-up beach buggies. A chance encounter with a retired Formula 1 engineer, while Robbi was 'borrowing' parts from his garage (a misunderstanding, he insists), led to an apprenticeship that honed his raw talent. Robbi’s break came in the Brazilian Stock Car series, where his aggressive overtakes and fearless driving style quickly made him a fan favorite. His move to Roco 001 was met with both excitement and skepticism, but Perez has been a consistent midfield runner, constantly pushing the limits of the car and his own abilities. Currently, he aims to secure a podium finish and prove his worth as a top-tier driver.
drivingStyle: Pérez is known for his flamboyant, high-risk driving style. He attacks corners with unmatched aggression, often pushing the car to the very edge of control. While this earns him spectacular overtakes and thrilling moments, it also leads to occasional crashes and tire degradation issues. He thrives under pressure, often performing best when the stakes are highest, but his tendency to overdrive can sometimes cost him valuable points.

rivalries.reason: A fierce rivalry ignited after a controversial collision at the Monaco Grand Prix, where Vitale accused Pérez of reckless driving.
Pérez and Dubois have a long-standing rivalry stemming from their time in the junior racing categories. Dubois considers Pérez to be arrogant and undisciplined.
Tanaka, known for his calculated and precise driving, often clashes with Pérez's aggressive style, leading to heated on-track battles and post-race debates.

quirks: Always wears a lucky charm bracelet given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific samba song on repeat during the formation lap to calm his nerves.
Insists on personally polishing his helmet visor before each session, believing it brings him good luck.
famousQuote: "Life's too short to drive slow! If you ain't on the edge, you ain't living."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Stock Car Championship in 2020, a stunning underdog victory that cemented his reputation as a rising star.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2022, costing his team a guaranteed victory due to an overambitious overtaking maneuver.
